text.cn: 沙子很白。有人走过你身后还回头盯。餐厅里有人抽烟；隔壁桌把卤味外带进海景位——你的 San 值对「公共场合」定义产生动摇。
text.en: White sand. People stare after passing. Someone smokes indoors; another brings takeout into the sea-view seat. Your sanity redefines "public space".

feedback.cn: 海水很舒服。相机电量先投降。
feedback.en: Sea feels great. Battery surrenders first.

text.cn: 礼貌请邻桌别在餐厅抽烟——收获困惑眼神。
text.en: Politely ask neighbors not to smoke indoors — confused looks.

feedback.cn: 文化冲突现场。你学会了：有时只能换座位。
feedback.en: Culture clash live. Sometimes you just change seats.

text.cn: 跟沙滩排球大爷打成一片。

feedback.cn: 你被叫「老外朋友」。出汗是社交货币。
feedback.en: They call you "foreign friend". Sweat is social currency.
